explanation: The `{...}` column specification for this `tabular` (or `array`) has a character TeX does not recognise as a column type. The built-in ones are `l`, `c`, `r`, `p{width}` and `|` for a vertical rule; anything else — a typo, or a column type from a package this document does not load — triggers this.
rawMessage: LaTeX Error: Illegal character in array arg.
title: An unknown column type in a table spec
